concept: Sequential read throughput of expert-sized reads by Apple SSD configuration
summary: Sequential read by SSD configuration is already covered (14.5 GB/s Apple FIO figure, 512 GB to 2 TB Mac Studio 5 to 7 GB/s, NAND package-count mechanism, Flash-MoE 17.5 GB/s contradiction); the only new source, DiskTruth, gives method but no numbers.
